roles.title: Software Engineer / Developer
roles.guidance_note: Acknowledge the mental drain of deep focus and constant context-switching. Use engineering-literate terms naturally (e.g. tech debt, refactoring, context-switching) without trying to debug their code.

roles.title: Product Manager
common_stressors: balancing competing executive and team demands
managing scope creep without demoralizing engineering
making high-impact decisions with incomplete data
roles.guidance_note: Focus on stakeholder tension, decision fatigue, and trade-off anxiety. Frame next steps around prioritization, clear communication boundaries, and micro-resets.

roles.title: UX / UI Designer
common_stressors: rushed handoffs with missing component states
roles.guidance_note: Validate creative exhaustion and subjective critique frustration. Use design-aware terms (wireframes, handoff, component library) with focus on boundary-setting.

roles.title: Data Analyst / Scientist
common_stressors: messy or missing raw data sources
ad-hoc requests derailing scheduled analytical projects
roles.guidance_note: Understand the tension between rigorous analytical depth and rushed business demands. Keep guidance grounded and step-focused.

roles.title: QA & Test Engineer
common_stressors: feeling like a bottleneck when catching late bugs
roles.guidance_note: Acknowledge the pressure of release quality responsibility. Validate their role as the advocate for reliability.

roles.title: Marketing & Content Specialist
common_stressors: measuring ROI under uncertain market conditions
creative burnout under tight content cadence
roles.guidance_note: Empathize with creative output pressures and metrics accountability. Offer grounding exercises for fast-paced shifts.

roles.title: People & Operations Specialist
common_stressors: absorbing emotional stress from other employees
roles.guidance_note: Recognize emotional labor and compassion fatigue. Encourage personal boundaries and self-care reset breaks.

roles.title: Engineering / Team Manager
common_stressors: shielding team from upper management pressure
feeling isolated between leadership and execution
roles.guidance_note: Respect leadership isolation and high-responsibility weight. Offer clear communication templates and stress relief strategies.

roles.title: Workplace Professional
roles.guidance_note: Provide empathetic, practical support for workplace stress, communication boundaries, and workload balancing.
